authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 3471 keśa explicitly gives Nepali/Hindi kes and Gawri khẽs hair. The exact kes/keś family fits, with contact transmission unresolved. Exact survey form keś is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 700 alagna explicitly lists Hindi/Nepali alag and regional alag/ālag separate. The different responses include transparent distributive repetition alag-alag; both repeated parts continue this same lexeme, not an unrelated second component. Exact survey form alagalag is retained; possible cross-Indo-Aryan transmission does not exclude this lexical-family link.
